name: orbit-browser
description: Orbit: Agentic AI Browser with Prompt Defense

scripts.backend: npm --prefix ../backend-node run build && npm --prefix ../backend-node run start
scripts.dev:processes: cross-env PROMPT_DEFENSE_DEV=true concurrently -k -n BACKEND,VITE,ELECTRON_TS,ELECTRON "npm run backend" "npm run vite:dev" "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --watch" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health dist-electron/main.js && electronmon ."
scripts.electron:start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n BACKEND,ELECTRON "npm run backend:prod" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run backend:build && tsc -b && npm run electron:build && vite build
scripts.test:audio: npm run build && playwright test e2e/liveTranscription.spec.ts --reporter=list
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e
